note: The input-selected topic name reaches the topic tree subscription path and identifies the Topic that will later receive a publish.
The input-selected publish topic resolves to the Topic containing the previously created subscriber.
Publishing marks the subscriber as having a pending outgoing message by incrementing numMessageIndices.
The subscriber pointer is linked as the head of the drainableSubscribers list while it still has pending drainage.
The subscriber is freed while it may still be the drainableSubscribers head; the safety obligation is that a subscriber with pending drainage must be unlinked before deletion.
A later global drain starts iterating from the stale drainableSubscribers pointer left by the freed subscriber.
drainImpl dereferences the freed subscriber pointer to read numMessageIndices, triggering a heap-use-after-free.
